environment.description: Application deployed identically but fronted by CloudFront distribution with AWS WAF WebACL attached. The WebACL includes three rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet at priority 100 in COUNT mode for baseline telemetry, (2) a custom rule group 'corp-input-length-limit' at priority 200 that blocks any request where any single query string parameter value exceeds 64 bytes (action: BLOCK, field: SingleQueryArgument with size constraint >64 using COMPRESSED_LENGTH comparison), (3) AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet at priority 300 but configured with all rules set to COUNT mode except 'SQLi_QUERYARGUMENTS' which remains in its default BLOCK action only for the label 'awswaf:managed:aws:sql-database:SQLi_QueryArguments'. CloudFront origin is configured with a custom origin header 'X-Origin-Verify' that the ALB validates, preventing direct origin access.

waf_web_acl_rules.name: corp-input-length-limit
waf_web_acl_rules.statement: SizeConstraintStatement on SingleQueryArgument values, ComparisonOperator GT, Size 64, TextTransformation COMPRESS_WHITE_SPACE

config.origin_access: Custom header X-Origin-Verify validated at ALB, direct origin access blocked
config.security_group_inbound: CloudFront managed prefix list only on port 443
